final: WITH g AS (SELECT t.observstation AS obs, o.weathprofile AS wp, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgband, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avgband) AS avg_of_avgband, AVG(cnt) AS avg_of_cnt FROM g
